\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 234-237 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R242-first-pass-words-from-chapters-234-237}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a button and a blouse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a post office, a city, a country, a capital city, a crossroads
  \item a direction, north, south, east, west
  \item a museum, a lane, a harbour, a fort, a palace
  \item especially, instead, not only, together, carefully
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A post office? (\textbf{\ta{அஞ்சலகம்}}, \emph{añcalakam}.) A city? (\textbf{\ta{நகரம்}}, \emph{nakaram}.) A country? (\textbf{\ta{நாடு}}, \emph{nāṭu}.) A capital city? (\textbf{\ta{தலைநகரம்}}, \emph{talainakaram}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{\ta{நாற்சந்தி}}, \emph{nāṟcanti}.) A direction? (\textbf{\ta{திசை}}, \emph{ticai}.) North? (\textbf{\ta{வடக்கு}}, \emph{vaṭakku}.) South? (\textbf{\ta{தெற்கு}}, \emph{teṟku}.) East? (\textbf{\ta{கிழக்கு}}, \emph{kiḻakku}.) West? (\textbf{\ta{மேற்கு}}, \emph{mēṟku}.) A museum? (\textbf{\ta{அருங்காட்சியகம்}}, \emph{aruṅkāṭciyakam}.) A lane? (\textbf{\ta{சந்து}}, \emph{cantu}.) A harbour? (\textbf{\ta{துறைமுகம்}}, \emph{tuṟaimukam}.) A fort? (\textbf{\ta{கோட்டை}}, \emph{kōṭṭai}.) A palace? (\textbf{\ta{அரண்மனை}}, \emph{araṇmaṉai}.) Especially? (\textbf{\ta{குறிப்பாக}}, \emph{kuṟippāka}.) Instead? (\textbf{\ta{அதற்குப்} \ta{பதிலாக}}, \emph{ataṟkup patilāka}.) Not only? (\textbf{\ta{மட்டுமல்லாமல்}}, \emph{maṭṭumallāmal}.) Together? (\textbf{\ta{ஒன்றாக}}, \emph{oṉṟāka}.) Carefully? (\textbf{\ta{கவனமாக}}, \emph{kavaṉamāka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 238-242 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R242-second-pass-words-from-chapters-238-242}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a colour and a size.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a colour, a size, weight, healthy, thin
  \item disappointment, pride, satisfaction, pity, loneliness
  \item firm, round, square, sharp, wonderful
  \item ordinary, rare, equal, rough, lukewarm
  \item clothing, trousers, a pocket, a button, a blouse
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A colour? (\textbf{\ta{நிறம்}}, \emph{niṟam}.) A size? (\textbf{\ta{அளவு}}, \emph{aḷavu}.) Weight? (\textbf{\ta{எடை}}, \emph{eṭai}.) Healthy? (\textbf{\ta{ஆரோக்கியமான}}, \emph{ārōkkiyamāṉa}.) Thin? (\textbf{\ta{ஒல்லியான}}, \emph{olliyāṉa}.) Disappointment? (\textbf{\ta{ஏமாற்றம்}}, \emph{ēmāṟṟam}.) Pride? (\textbf{\ta{பெருமை}}, \emph{perumai}.) Satisfaction? (\textbf{\ta{திருப்தி}}, \emph{tirupti}.) Pity? (\textbf{\ta{இரக்கம்}}, \emph{irakkam}.) Loneliness? (\textbf{\ta{தனிமை}}, \emph{taṉimai}.) Firm? (\textbf{\ta{உறுதியான}}, \emph{uṟutiyāṉa}.) Round? (\textbf{\ta{வட்டமான}}, \emph{vaṭṭamāṉa}.) Square? (\textbf{\ta{சதுரமான}}, \emph{caturamāṉa}.) Sharp? (\textbf{\ta{கூர்மையான}}, \emph{kūrmaiyāṉa}.) Wonderful? (\textbf{\ta{அருமையான}}, \emph{arumaiyāṉa}.) Ordinary? (\textbf{\ta{சாதாரணமான}}, \emph{cātāraṇamāṉa}.) Rare? (\textbf{\ta{அபூர்வமான}}, \emph{apūrvamāṉa}.) Equal? (\textbf{\ta{சமமான}}, \emph{camamāṉa}.) Rough? (\textbf{\ta{கரடுமுரடான}}, \emph{karaṭumuraṭāṉa}.) Lukewarm? (\textbf{\ta{வெதுவெதுப்பான}}, \emph{vetuvetuppāṉa}.) Clothing? (\textbf{\ta{ஆடை}}, \emph{āṭai}.) Trousers? (\textbf{\ta{கால்சட்டை}}, \emph{kālcaṭṭai}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\ta{சட்டைப்பை}}, \emph{caṭṭaippai}.) A button? (\textbf{\ta{பொத்தான்}}, \emph{pottāṉ}.) A blouse? (\textbf{\ta{ரவிக்கை}}, \emph{ravikkai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
